freeze_effective_rule: The Git commit that writes this v2 manifest is the new prospective freeze point after the credential-history rewrite. Only predictions with issue_time_utc strictly after this refreeze commit may count as prospective Model v4 evidence.

security_history_rewrite.note: The security rewrite exposed a pre-existing mismatch between SHA-256 values recorded before commit and the canonical bytes stored in Git. This v2 manifest records the canonical Git bytes used by the live verification workflow. The frozen numerical model state is unchanged.

legacy_embedded_source_hashes.interpretation: These values remain inside the already-frozen artifact as historical provenance metadata. They are not used as the canonical post-rewrite Git-byte verification hashes.

historical_development.forward_target: flood event anchor in next 1-3 days; D-3 through D-1 are positive prediction dates
historical_development.interpretation: Development evidence only. Sensitivity is sufficient for a shadow experiment but historical false-positive burden and precision explicitly fail the production replacement gate.

rainfall.rule: Use only completed daily accumulations available by prediction issue time.

river.rule: Use an operational forecast cycle already issued at prediction time; current-day cycle may fall back to the previous issued cycle if the new cycle is not yet available.

surface_state.rule: Source identity and observation date must be preserved in each prospective record.

next_generation_rule: Any post-refreeze change to coefficients, features, calibration or threshold creates a new model generation and cannot reuse this generation's future prospective evidence as untouched acceptance evidence.
